integrity: The theorem is proved using Sun divisibility, Kummer valuation and exact arithmetic progressions; finite computations are corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Classifies immediate versus delayed first obstruction when a is a prime power of exponent at least two and 1 <= b < a; does not determine subsequent index in delayed cases. Literature priority remains subject to incomplete coverage.
title: A logarithmic first-obstruction law for prime-power binomial divisibility
